fallbacks.title: Platform defaults for uncovered controls
fallbacks.statement: If the system defines no control for a need, use the platform's native element with the leader field styling; keep native semantics.
constraints: mark the improvisation and report a gap

fallbacks.title: Selection beyond small sets
fallbacks.statement: Small sets use a native select styled like a field; larger or filtered selection uses the platform default, marked.
constraints: report a gap if the need recurs

fallbacks.title: Interstitials become ruled panels
fallbacks.statement: No dialog canon: interstitials render as plain ruled panels in the page flow (L-07); mark the improvisation.
